text: Two continuous maps f, g: X → Y are homotopic if:
choices: there exists a continuous H: X × [0,1] → Y with H(x,0)=f(x) and H(x,1)=g(x)
f and g agree on a dense subset
explanation: A homotopy H is a continuous deformation from f to g. Homotopy is an equivalence relation on maps; homotopy equivalence of spaces is the induced equivalence on identities.
